title: Mike Vrabel emerges unscathed, for now, after resignation of Dianna Russini

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Vrabel emerges unscathed, for now, after resignation of Dianna Russini
sources.description: One week ago, no one knew what would happen regarding the photos published by the New York Post of Patriots coach Mike Vrabel and The Athletic reporter Dianna Russini.
